name: Qwen
summary: Alibaba Cloud's model family, and the most prolific release schedule in the field by a wide margin — base, instruct, coder, math, vision and audio variants at half a dozen sizes each. Nearly all of it is open weights, which is why so much of the fine-tuned long tail starts here.

founders.name: Alibaba Cloud
founders.bio: Alibaba's cloud arm; the Qwen team sits inside it and ships under the Tongyi brand in China.
